messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up — BrightPath activation is blocked. Support stack shows their prod API keys never provisioned, onboarding stuck at step 4. Customer is on an annual plan, renewal due in ~45 days. They’ve started raising questions with billing.
Liam O'Connor: Ugh. Any error codes/logs?
Maya Singh: 403 during key mint: `requestId=5463f, error=forbidden, msg=service_account_missing_role`
Maya Singh: Their onboarding engineer reports they completed the admin link step, but our provisioning job didn’t finish. Link: https://internal.ops/redwood/prov/BRIGHTPATH-431
SupportBot: Ticket #CS-9812 created and linked to thread. SLA: 4h.
Javier Ruiz: I can take the triage. Nina — can you run a key re-provision from the console while I check the infra logs?
Nina Patel: On it. Will try a manual re-provision and report back in 15m.
Maya Singh: Customer is in EMEA, asking for an ETA. They mentioned they’ve paused feature rollout for next week if not resolved.
Liam O'Connor: Ok, priority escalate to CS playbook: 1) Confirm workaround 2) Provide comms plan 3) Escalate to infra if needed.
Javier Ruiz: Infra logs show the provisioning job timed out with `503 upstream_unavailable` at 2024-11-20T09:12:03Z. Looks like a transient capacity hiccup in the EU cluster.
Nina Patel: Manual re-provision succeeded — key issued. I sent the key to the customer via secure link and asked them to retry.
Maya Singh: They say the SDK now authenticates. Thanks Nina. They still want a postmortem and reassurance about recurrence.
Liam O'Connor: Great. Next steps: a) Confirm production traffic is flowing for BrightPath b) Draft a short comms note for the customer explaining root cause + mitigation c) Trigger renewal health flag so AM knows risk.
Javier Ruiz: I'll open an infra incident for EU cluster capacity, link to this thread and request priority review.
Liam O'Connor: Maya — can you draft the comms? Keep it short: what happened, what we did, how we’re preventing recurrence, and offer a follow-up call. Use apologetic tone and propose a 1:1 with AM.
Maya Singh: Drafting now. Will ping for review in #customer-success-drafts.
Nina Patel: Confirming metrics: BrightPath has 12 successful calls in last 10m, latency normal.
Maya Singh: Draft uploaded: "We’re sincerely sorry for the interruption. Root cause: transient capacity error in our EU provisioning cluster caused the key mint to timeout. Fix: manual re-provision + infra mitigation underway. Prevention: added retry window and autoscale rule to provisioning job; infra is investigating longer-term capacity adjustments. We’ll follow up with a postmortem and a 1:1. —Maya, CS"
Liam O'Connor: Nice. Javier — please include expected ETA for infra mitigation in the incident ticket.
Javier Ruiz: Added ETA: infra estimates a hotfix in 6-8 hours, capacity plan update in 3 business days.
Maya Singh: Sending note to customer now and scheduling a 30-min call for tomorrow. CC: AM (Olivia Tan).
SupportBot: CS-9812 status: resolved (workaround applied).
Liam O'Connor: Closing loop items: - Confirm postmortem and share with customer - Mark renewal risk as "monitored" and notify AM - Follow up if any regression within 72h
Maya Singh: Will handle the CS tasks and update the renewal risk tracker.
Nina Patel: I’ll keep an eye on EU provisioning metrics and report any anomalies.
Javier Ruiz: I’ll follow up with infra and paste incident link here once updated.
Maya Singh: Thanks everyone :tada:
Liam O'Connor: Thanks team.
Maya Singh: /remind @Olivia Tan 24h "Follow up with BrightPath on postmortem and renewal touchpoint"
